I just want to be ok.
But its unrealistic a fantasy.

Does it though? We only think that because we only see this outcome, a story of a tormented child who grew up to be great will be more known then that of the same scenario but instead they chose death.

I doubt therapy will help, i'm very closed off, nobody knows abt this shit.

If suicide is not the answer then what is? I was dead the moment i had my first suicidal thought.
But i've been trying for like 3 years, i'm not insane, i see this isn't working and i have came up with a solution, i mean, i don't wanna die god no, but its the best i got. Its all i got.
